def build_feature_matrix(df: pd.DataFrame, formula_col: str = "formula_pretty") -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Convert formula strings to composition objects via StrToComposition,
    compute ElementFraction features, and flatten into DataFrame.
    """
    converter = StrToComposition()
    compositions = converter.featurize_df(df, col_id=formula_col, ignore_errors=True)
    ef = ElementFraction()
    frac_df = ef.featurize_df(df, col_id=formula_col, multiindex=False)
    frac_df.columns = [str(c) for c in frac_df.columns]
    result = pd.concat([df.reset_index(drop=True), frac_df.reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1)
    return result
